iti48:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti48:2.3: yo ca abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, yo ca paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carantaṃ amūlakena abrahmacariyena anuddhaṃseti.
iti48:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave dve āpāyikā nerayikā idamappahāyāti.
iti48:3.2: yo vāpi katvā na karomi cāha,
iti48:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
